quoted_instead.definition: CREATE TRIGGER quoted_instead INSTEAD OF DELETE ON public."Order" FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE PROCEDURE public."fn_X"('it''s', 'a,b');

truncate_row.definition: CREATE TRIGGER truncate_row AFTER TRUNCATE ON public."Order" FOR EACH ROW WHEN (("a)") = ')') EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_trunc()

multi.definition: CREATE TRIGGER multi BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF "Order", a OR DELETE ON public."Order" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_multi()

bare.definition: CREATE TRIGGER bare AFTER INSERT ON public."Order" EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_bare()

escaped_ident.definition: CREATE TRIGGER escaped_ident BEFORE UPDATE OF "a""b", fn$1 ON public."Order" EXECUTE FUNCTION public."fn""x"()

fn_plain.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_plain() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN; END $$;

fn_setof.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_setof() RETURNS SETOF integer LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT 1 $$;

fn_no_body.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_no_body() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE internal

fn_trigger(a uuid, b text).definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_trigger(a uuid, b text) RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $fn$

fn_cast.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_cast() RETURNS text AS CAST LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT 1 $$

fn_word.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION fn_word() -- xreturns trigger €
RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql

fn_unclosed.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_unclosed() RETURNS integer AS $fn$ BEGIN SELECT 1

fn_bare_language.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_bare_language() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE

returns_trigger_name.definition: CREATE FUNCTION returns_trigger_name() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql

fn_open(uuid.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_open(uuid RETURNS integer AS $tag BEGIN SELECT 1

fn_aside.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_aside() aside languages sql
